create.name: Darren Austin Hall
create.bio:
Darren Austin Hall is a sound healer, mystic musician and wisdom teacher whose work turns on what he calls the re-enchantment of the world: a renewed reverence for the Earth, pictured through the figure of Gaia-Sophia, with voice and music used as a spiritual practice. His training includes a diploma in acupuncture and Chinese medicine in Toronto, a 500-hour yoga teacher course, two years of study in Shaking Medicine with Bradford Keeney, time spent learning from First Nations elders, and a transpersonal coaching programme in Findhorn.

Through his Source Resonance Academy he runs residential sound trainings in Costa Rica, one-day intensives and online mentoring for people learning to guide sound journeys with crystal bowls, shruti box and channelled singing. He also hosts Temple of the Wild ecstatic dances, runs men's groups built around the masculine archetypes, and offers Wise Soul mentoring that draws on myth and archetypal psychology. His online course Honour All Creation sets teaching films beside his double album of the same name, and on YouTube he records Wisdom Warrior talks that link astrology and Gnostic ideas with the questions of the day. He has released several albums and a book of poems and essays on love and sacred sexuality, Love's Revolution, and divides his year between Costa Rica and Scotland.

courses.title: Honour All Creation: A New Earth Journey
courses.description: A self-paced online course in two parts, Earth and Sky, of eleven chapters each. Every chapter pairs a teaching film made in Costa Rica with a song from his album of the same name and a practice, exploring Earth-centred spirituality and the myth of Gaia-Sophia.
courses.price: $99 CAD per part; $169 CAD for both

courses.title: Source Resonance Sound Healing Training Retreat
courses.description: A residential training held each year at a riverside retreat in southern Costa Rica. Participants learn to use the voice and instruments such as crystal bowls, study mantra and the yoga of sound, and practise leading sound baths and sound journeys for groups.

courses.title: Sound Evolution Mentorship
courses.description: One-to-one mentoring over Zoom for sound practitioners, yoga teachers and musicians who want to grow their sound work, from shaping a sound journey to opening the singing voice. It begins with a free half-hour call and runs as single sessions or longer pathways.

courses.title: Wise Soul Mentoring
courses.description: Mentoring sessions that look at a person's life through myth, archetype and the idea of destiny, for times of transition or questions of purpose. It starts with a discovery call.

free_resources.title: Musica Universalis: Sound Healing Library
free_resources.description: An open page of his recorded sound channellings, crystal bowl journeys and short teachings, gathered from the Source Resonance Academy.
